name: Blog Content Automation – AI SEO autopilot for your blog
author: Trafficontent

sections.description:
Organic traffic can save thousands in ad spend, but writing daily blogs manually means wasted hours, strict discipline, and burnout.

👉 With Trafficontent, everything runs on autopilot:
• One-click automation handles research, writing, SEO optimization, and publishing.
• Auto-publishes directly to Shopify and WordPress.
• 🌱 Plant a seed today and let your content grow by itself.

Key Benefits
1. Scalable Strategy – Works for solopreneurs, small teams, and growing businesses.
2. Boost SEO & Traffic – Consistent, optimized content improves rankings and drives organic visitors.
3. Save Time – Eliminate writer’s block and focus on your business.
4. AI That Understands Your Niche – Fashion, tech, wellness, e-commerce, and more.
5. Custom Scheduling – Daily, weekly, or monthly publishing.
6. Multi-Platform Support – Publish seamlessly to Shopify and WordPress.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Trafficontent.com API to register your WordPress site for automated blog scheduling and AI-powered content generation.

With your explicit consent, it sends your site URL and admin email once upon installation to create a linked channel. To enable API-based publishing, an Application Password is automatically generated for the current admin user and sent securely to Trafficontent.

No additional sensitive data is collected or stored beyond this credential, and all blog content remains on your local WordPress site.

Service: https://trafficontent.com
Terms of Use: https://trafficontent.com/terms-service/
Privacy Policy: https://trafficontent.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin.
  2. Activate.
  3. Visit the “Trafficontent” menu.
  4. On the Welcome screen, check the consent checkbox and click Connect Trafficontent.

🧭 = How to Use the Trafficontent Plugin =
1. Install and Activate the plugin, then click Connect Trafficontent on the welcome screen.
You’ll be redirected to the Trafficontent Dashboard.
2. Inside the dashboard:
• ✅ Set your target keywords
• ✅ Use the Scheduler tab to choose your preferred posting days and frequency
3. Once the schedule is saved:
• 🎯 Trafficontent will automatically generate and publish blog posts to your WordPress site
• 📬 You’ll receive an email notification with the blog title and direct URL every time a post is published
• 🗂️ You can view your blog content in the dashboard under Articles or Content:
👉 https://trafficontent.com/creator/Articles/
sections.faq:
How does Trafficontent generate blogs?

It connects with trafficontent.com API to use AI to generate, schedule, and post blog content.

Will this plugin help with SEO rankings?

Yes! Trafficontent generates SEO-optimized blog articles using targeted keywords, consistent scheduling, and structured formatting that search engines love.
